logs the whole RefundRecord (carrying authorizationCode in cleartext), and the
failure-path ERROR line dumps the whole inbound RefundRequest.

this codebase -- only the log-line leak -- so do not add one here.
anti_gaming_check.py re-injects these into a throwaway copy of the repo and re-runs the
participant's own F1 test. A test that still passes with the leak restored was never
